items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: When was Tom Albuquerque with you? ... Oh he just quit the band here

ctx.x: Oh, he, he, he just quit the band here and got too old to play. Oh, I see. He don't play no more.
When was he with you? When was Tom Albuquerque with you?
Oh he just quit the band here and got too old to play. He don't play no more. Yes I know. Oh he first was a violin player. To play violin. He live out there on McGonagall
